name: Environment Config Split Integration
description: Automatically registers every Config Split as an available environment in Environment Context.
project_description: A submodule of Environment Context. When enabled it subscribes to Environment Context's AvailableEnvironmentsEvent and adds every Config Split (loaded through config_split.manager) as an available environment, using the split's id as the machine name and the split's label. It has no UI and provides no configuration; it only makes existing Config Splits appear as selectable environments (for example in the 'Current environment' condition). It does not change how the active environment is detected and does not activate or deactivate any split.
